verdict.rationale: Secureframe publishes an llms.txt at secureframe.com/llms.txt (docs-48), and it offers agent-oriented documentation for its MCP server at mcp.secureframe.com/mcp_docs (docs-37, docs-38) plus a machine-readable OpenAPI 3.0 spec embedded in its API reference. Together these give an agent clear entry points. The only llms.txt snippet in evidence is marketing copy about NIST 800-171, so its depth for developer use is unclear. missing for 10: evidence that llms.txt indexes developer/API/MCP docs, a standalone raw OpenAPI download, independent or hands-on corroboration of agents consuming these docs.
